scenes.name: THREE SLITS
lines: Open one slit, and light lands evenly on the screen. Open two, and stripes appear.
开一条缝，光均匀地落在屏上；开两条缝，条纹就出来了。
That is interference: some places get more than the two slits alone, some get less.
这就是干涉：有的地方比两条缝各开一次之和多，有的地方少。
Now open a third. Does it bring a new interference, one that needs all three at once?
再开第三条缝：会不会冒出一种新的干涉，非得三条缝同时在场才有？

scenes.name: SQUARE OF A SUM
lines: At one point on the screen, each open slit sends an arrow: its amplitude.
屏上某一点，每条开着的缝都送来一支箭头：它的振幅。
The arrows add head to tail. Here they sum to length two, so the weight is four.
箭头首尾相接；这里加起来长度是 2，权重就是 2² = 4。
Multiply the sum by its own conjugate, and you get nine tiles.
把这个和乘以它自己的共轭，展开来一共九块。
Each tile pairs one slit with one slit: three on the diagonal, six that mix two slits.
每一块只把一条缝和一条缝配成一对：对角线上三块，另外六块各混两条缝。
No tile ever holds all three slits.
没有哪一块同时装着三条缝。

scenes.name: SEVEN WEIGHTS
lines: Sorkin's test takes seven weights: all three, minus each pair, plus each single slit.
索金的检验取七个权重：三缝全开，减去每一对，再加回每一条单缝。
Follow a diagonal tile: plus one with all three, minus two in the pairs, plus one alone. Zero.
盯住一块对角块：三缝里 +1，两对里 −2，单缝里 +1，合起来是零。
A mixed tile appears only with all three and in its own pair: plus one, minus one. Zero again.
一块交叉块只在三缝和它自己那一对里出现：+1，−1，又是零。
At sixty degrees: four, minus three, one and three, plus three ones. Zero.
With every arrow equal to one: nine, minus three fours, plus three ones. Zero.

scenes.name: SLIDE THE DETECTOR
lines: Now slide the detector across the screen. Every arrow turns, and every weight changes.
现在让探测点沿着屏幕滑动：每支箭头都在转，每个权重都在变。
Yet the three-slit pattern is always the three pair patterns, minus the three single slits.
可三缝图样始终等于三对双缝图样之和，减去三条单缝。
The pair terms swing up and down. The third-order term stays flat at zero.
两两的交叉项起起落落，三阶项却一路平躺在零上。

scenes.name: WHY A SQUARE
lines: Why a square? Lean checks that for a pure state and a one-line shutter, the weight is the squared modulus of their inner product.
为什么是平方？Lean 内核检验：纯态配一维快门，权重就是两者内积的模平方。
The inner product is linear, so the amplitude is a sum over the slits.
内积是线性的，所以振幅就是各条缝的振幅之和。
A slit can be a whole bundle of paths. Lean checks that the seven terms cancel for any three disjoint bundles.
“缝”可以是一束路径；Lean 内核检验：三束互不相交时，七项相消为零。
It holds in any commutative ring with a conjugation. The proof just expands the square.
这在任何带共轭的交换环里都成立；证明只是把平方展开。

scenes.name: ONE WAY ONLY
lines: With a fourth power instead, equal arrows give eighty-one, minus forty-eight, plus three: thirty-six.
换成四次方，三支相等的箭头给出 81 − 48 + 3 = 36。
A fourth-power rule would leave a true three-way term.
四次方的规则会留下真正的三方干涉项。
The street runs one way. A square weight forces the third-order term to vanish.
这是单行道：平方权重迫使三阶项为零。
A zero third-order term alone does not single out the Born rule, and the identity ignores leaks between real slits.
单凭三阶项为零挑不出玻恩规则；这条恒等式也不管真实狭缝之间的串扰。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, chapter two.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第二章
